## Governance

| Read capability | any project member |

| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | **no** — invariant `audit-actor` is not met here yet |

Deployment metadata, not a public catalog. Browser roles have no table grants or policies. Only database maintenance configures the issuer; the service role may read it. The verified SQL resolver reads it as its owner. A missing or mismatched issuer fails closed. D309 tracks deployment acceptance.

> **RLS is on and this table has no policy.** That is deny-all for every role except
> `service_role`, which bypasses RLS. If a page reads this table directly and gets zero
> rows, this is why.
